preconditions.description: The number of nodes in the tree s is between 2 and 10^5, inclusive.
The nodes ai and bi in each edge are between 1 and n, inclusive.
Each edge ai and bi does not connect a node to itself.
The given tree s is a valid tree structure.

postconditions.expression: m is the number of nodes in the optimal T-decomposition
postconditions.description: The output m is the number of nodes in the optimal T-decomposition.

postconditions.expression: Each line describing a node xi contains ki + 1 integers, where ki is the number of nodes in the initial tree s contained in xi
postconditions.description: Each line describing a node xi contains ki + 1 integers, where ki is the number of nodes in the initial tree s contained in xi.

postconditions.expression: The union of all xi equals v
postconditions.description: The union of all xi equals the set of all nodes v in the initial tree s.

postconditions.expression: For any edge (a, b) in the initial tree s, there exists a node t in the T-decomposition containing both a and b
postconditions.description: For any edge (a, b) in the initial tree s, there exists a node t in the T-decomposition containing both a and b.

postconditions.expression: All nodes of the T-decomposition that contain node a of the initial tree s form a connected subtree
postconditions.description: All nodes of the T-decomposition that contain node a of the initial tree s form a connected subtree.

postconditions.expression: The weight of the T-decomposition is the maximum cardinality of its nodes
postconditions.description: The weight of the T-decomposition is the maximum cardinality of its nodes.

postconditions.expression: The optimal T-decomposition has the minimum possible number of nodes among all optimal T-decompositions
postconditions.description: The optimal T-decomposition has the minimum possible number of nodes among all optimal T-decompositions.
